title: Babar Azam Ridiculed By Former Pakistan Stars On Live TV, Sparks Outrage | Watch | Cricket News - News18
text: Ace Pakistan batter Babar Azam was mocked by his former teammates on live television, a video of which has gone viral on social media, with the clip sparking mixed reactions from fans on both sides of the border, just a few days ahead of the marquee India-Pakistan clash. After a disappointing 15 off 18 in Pakistan’s T20 World Cup opener against the Netherlands, Babar bounced back with 46 off 32 against the USA. Still, some former teammates remain sceptical about his ability to perform against India in Sunday’s high-stakes clash. On live TV, Ahmed Shehzad, Mohammad Amir and Rashid Latif mocked Babar and even placed outlandish bets on his potential contribution in the match. On a Pakistani TV show, Shehzad joked that he would provide food for the entire audience and support staff if Babar wins the match for Pakistan. Amir added he might even come out of retirement if Babar scores 50+ runs at a strike rate above 150. “The crowd coordinator won’t have to get food that day. The whole team will get food," Shehzad said. “If Babar, let us say, with a strike rate of 160… Yes. Keep it like that. If he plays innings with a strike rate of 160 and helps Pakistan win, Amir will take his retirement back," the show host added. “Let us be realistic. If he plays a match-winning inning with a strike rate of 150 and scores 50 plus, then all these conditions are on," Shehzad replied and Amir agreed. Watch the video here: “He does not even bat that long," Latif quipped. In five T20Is against India, Babar has scored 105 runs, at an average of 26.25 and a strike rate of 128, one that he would have to improve to have any chance of pushing Pakistan to a win in the big game.
